items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1961-02-07
items.q: you told me that you played with Buddy Petit's band. Yeah.

ctx.x: Well, we saw it with a little night club, you know? Oh, yeah. Yeah, a little night club.

Yeah. How often would you work there? How many times a week? Every night. Every night, seven nights a week. Mm-hmm. Oh, yeah. Once we're on these early things, I think we'd have to do a little dance club. One of these early things, you told me that you played with Buddy Petit's band. Yeah. Well, you remember what, if you had a name for that band, what was it called, that band? The name of his band? It was Buddy Petit. It was all the name called. That's all they called it. Yeah. That was his name. How about…
Well, John Robichaud had his band name after him. But the Maple Leaf band, it was owned by old Kyle Gasper. But they used to call it the Maple Leaf Orchestra. That was an orchestra.
